Deluxe Garden View Bungalows

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-1394e64a elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: Each of our six bungalows offers 39 sqm of indoor space and an 11 sqm private lanai, built using regional materials by skilled local artisans. Inside, you’ll find custom-made Jepara teak furniture, premium King Koil beds, and a private bathroom with a rain shower and sustainable amenities. For year-round comfort, each bungalow is equipped with air conditioning and a ceiling fan, while the lanai provides a peaceful spot to relax.

children.html:
How many rooms does Mocean Beach Resort have?

Ten: six Deluxe Garden View Bungalows with private lanai and four Standard Rooms.

Can I bring a child?

Yes. Rooms take up to three guests, and one cot or child’s fold-out bed can be added. Rollaway beds aren’t available.

Is the tap water drinkable?

Every tap runs reverse-osmosis purified water, so you can refill your bottle in the room.
